description: §14.8.9 S441 round 5 (F4) — an element a collection method hands back (`find` / `filter` / `at` / `pop` / `sort`, `Map.get`, `Object.values`, an iterator's `.next().value`) IS an element of the collection; a write into it lands in the collection, so returning the collection is E-PROTECT-006.
rationale: MEASURED before the fix (S441 round-4 review, F4): the write reached no binding (the alias walk stopped at the call) and the route served the hash inside the array.
